attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline (RI Department of Health)

rules.unit: AMA PRA Category 1 Credit / AOA Category 1a credits
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1 Credit; AOA Category 1a
rules.alternatives: Participation in an ABMS Maintenance of Certification program or the AOA Osteopathic Continuous Certification (OCC) program is considered equivalent to meeting the CME requirement. Board members' meeting time counts hour for hour.
rules.audit_note: Only a summary list of CME documents is submitted with the renewal; certificates must be kept 3 years for Board review. Renewal is denied without satisfactory CME evidence; the Board may grant one 6-month extension.
rules.notes: One board and one rule for MD and DO. CME must be earned on or before June 1 of each even-numbered year; licenses expire July 1 of even-numbered years. The rule (effective 08/26/2026) lists no mandatory topics; proposed changes are pending.
